_comment: Movable Indian festival dates used as forecast features (festival day + days-to-festival).
Single source of truth: read by the Python agent (agent/app/festivals.py) and by the Next.js app (src/lib/prep/festivals.ts).
Dates are the main national observance day; regional observance can differ by a day (see per-entry notes).
Verified 2026-10-16 against timeanddate.com India holiday lists (sources below). Re-check Eid dates for 2027: they depend on moon sighting.
Christmas is a fixed date (also in FIXED_HOLIDAYS_IN); it is listed here so days-to-festival counts down to it too.

festivals.name: Eid al-Fitr (Ramzan Id)
festivals.note: 2027 is listed as tentative by timeanddate.com (moon sighting).

festivals.name: Eid al-Adha (Bakrid)
festivals.note: 2027 is listed as tentative by timeanddate.com (moon sighting).

festivals.name: Diwali (Lakshmi Puja)
festivals.note: 2024: national gazetted holiday on Oct 31; drikpanchang (New Delhi) and Maharashtra observed Lakshmi Puja on Nov 1.
